steps.name: Read-only machine and runtime preflight
actions: Inspect worker health, runtime hashes, bindings, model presence and current active processes
Run V5 readiness audit and run audit in read-only mode
acceptance: No runtime mutation is performed
Runtime commit and hashes are known
Publication remains disabled

steps.name: Synthetic intra-scene timeline
actions: Render a disposable ~9 second scene with timed caption, callout, object movement and accent
Verify a stable background and exact event windows
acceptance: No unnecessary full-image replacement
Timed events occur in expected windows
Publication lock audit passes

steps.name: ComfyUI FLUX preview
actions: Generate 1-2 PREVIEW scenes with one candidate per scene
Measure image throughput and confirm low-VRAM sequential behavior
acceptance: PREVIEW uses one candidate per scene
No unrelated GPU process is interrupted
Image timing telemetry is populated
Publication lock audit passes

steps.name: Real Hibou pose registry
actions: Validate one ready pose with SHA256
Render static reuse and one timed pose event
acceptance: Only ready pose assets are reused
No planned pose is generated implicitly
Pose identity stays visually consistent

steps.name: Chatterbox prosody and duration
actions: Synthesize the exact sentence 'Et tu repayes cette marge. Chaque année.'
Compare prosody plan, waveform duration and verbatim transcript
acceptance: Transcript remains verbatim
Second unit is slower and more appuyé
Pause is audible
Duration QC passes or produces bounded deterministic retry

steps.name: Music mix and ducking
actions: Mix a rights-controlled local test track
Inspect fades, ducking and loudness, then perform human listening
acceptance: Voice remains intelligible
No clipping or pumping
No uncontrolled-rights asset is used

steps.name: Local semantic creative QC calibration
actions: Run known-good and known-bad local image fixtures through CLIP/SigLIP-compatible QC
Calibrate advisory thresholds before any blocking mode
acceptance: No network or paid fallback is used
Known-good and known-bad fixtures are separable
Reasons and scores are persisted
Blocking remains disabled until calibration is accepted

steps.name: Incremental PREVIEW A to B
actions: Create a disposable PREVIEW A then caption-only, image-only and narration-only variants
Verify reuse lineage, parent master hash and actual cache hits
acceptance: Caption-only keeps voice and image cache reusable
Image-only keeps voice reusable and regenerates only affected visual path
Narration-only reuses images
Parent worker/content/hash integrity checks pass
Review diff and scene_review_queue match real invalidations

steps.name: Human candidate checkpoint and resume
actions: Run FINAL until WAITING_HUMAN_SELECTION
Choose candidates against the exact review fingerprint and resume the same job
acceptance: Images are not regenerated after human selection
Stale fingerprint is rejected
Waiting marker is removed only after valid selection
Human decision remains distinct from machine recommendation

steps.name: Remote cancel and supersede
actions: Cancel a disposable job during Chatterbox and ComfyUI
Repeat with supersede
acceptance: Only matching owned child tree and ComfyUI client prompts stop
No unrelated process is killed
No normal retry is scheduled
Worker proceeds to next job

steps.name: Two-phase remote repair resume
actions: Fail a disposable job and generate a resume plan
Perform prepare phase with first human confirmation
Perform start phase with second human confirmation and immutable hashes
acceptance: Prepare ends in Paused without starting master
Start requires all four immutable proofs
Requests are one-shot
Caches and artifacts remain preserved
Publication remains locked

steps.name: Complete V5 final video
actions: Render one complete disposable V5 FINAL
Perform human review V4 and incremental-aware review manifest inspection
acceptance: All selected V5 features behave coherently together
Human review remains mandatory
Artifact registry and durable storage plan are complete
Publication lock audit passes

steps.name: Final publication lock and artifact audit
actions: Run publication lock audit, run audit and durable storage plan audit on the completed disposable run
acceptance: No publication or auto-publish signal is true
All expected hashes and references are present
No uploader or publication action is performed
